8.title: Slack and GitHub with the same question
8.body: Connected data sources are searched alongside files. You can add or turn off sources anytime in Settings.

9.title: Reconfigure anytime with {{shortcut}}
9.body: Change folder scope, AI model, and data sources in Settings. Changing the embedding location will re-index from scratch.

sidebar.description: Choose which items and sections appear in the sidebar, reorder them, or customize by chatting with the AI assistant.
sidebar.aiHeroDesc: Ask in plain words — for example, "Hide Music and Movies and move Downloads and Documents to the top."
sidebar.favoritesDesc: Toggle and reorder your favorite places. AI Search and Automations are core features and are always shown.
sidebar.lockedHint: AI Search and Automations are required core features and cannot be hidden.
sidebar.addCustomModalDesc: Enter a folder path to pin to the sidebar Favorites section.
sidebar.sectionsDesc: Manage the order and visibility of Favorites, Cloud, Locations, and Tags in one place. AI Search and Automations are core features and are always shown.

assistant.title: AI App Customizer
assistant.emptyTitle: How would you like to customize Dazzi?
assistant.emptyDesc: Tell the assistant which folders to show, how to order them, or switch themes — changes apply live.
assistant.promptHideMedia: Hide the Music, Movies, and Pictures folders I don't use for work
assistant.promptReorder: Move Downloads and Documents to the top of Favorites
assistant.promptReset: Put the sidebar back the way it was

contextMenu.description: Configure built-in items and custom Magic Actions (shell scripts and AI agent loops) shown when right-clicking files and folders.
contextMenu.aiHeroTitle: Customize Context Menu & Magic Actions with AI
contextMenu.aiHeroDesc: Ask in plain words — for example, "Add a right-click action on PDFs that summarizes them in 3 bullets" or "Hide Compress 7z and Copy Path."
contextMenu.shortcutNote: Keyboard shortcuts on built-in actions stay standard to Finder and cannot be reassigned here.
contextMenu.magicDesc: Pass right-clicked files into any shell command or run an AI agent loop to analyze, convert, or organize them.
contextMenu.magicEmpty: No Magic Actions yet. Ask the AI assistant or add one manually.
contextMenu.sectionsDesc: Manage the order of sections and visibility of built-in menu items in one place. Tags is an essential feature and always remains shown.
contextMenu.lockedHint: Tags is a required core item and cannot be hidden.

editor.desc: Configure a shell command or AI agent prompt that runs with the right-clicked file(s) as input.
editor.labelPlaceholder: e.g. Summarize PDF in 3 Bullets, Compute SHA-256
editor.modeOrganize: Create & Modify Files (convert, edit, organize, shell)
editor.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Summarize the key points of the selected document and extract action items as a table.
editor.useSkillsHint: Share skills installed for the AutoRAG agent with this Magic Action (on by default).
editor.useMcpHint: Allow calling connected MCP servers (such as Aside MCP) from this Magic Action (on by default).
editor.commandHint: Selected paths are passed as positional arguments ("$@") and in env vars DAZZI_FILES_JSON, DAZZI_FILE, and DAZZI_FILE_COUNT.
editor.extensionsPlaceholder: Leave blank for all · e.g. pdf, docx, md
editor.commandHintWindows: Runs in Windows PowerShell with selected paths passed in $args and env vars $env:DAZZI_FILES_JSON, $env:DAZZI_FILE, and $env:DAZZI_FILE_COUNT.

assistant.title: AI Context Menu & Magic Action Assistant
assistant.emptyTitle: What should appear when you right-click?
assistant.emptyDesc: Build your own right-click actions that summarize, compare, or tidy up files, or hide the menu items you don't use.
assistant.promptSummarizeDoc: Make a Magic Action that sums up a PDF or Word document in three lines when I right-click it
assistant.promptCompareFiles: Make a Magic Action that lists what changed between two files I select and right-click
assistant.promptPaperToDiscord: Make a Magic Action that summarizes a PDF paper, posts the summary to my Discord #paper-summaries channel, and saves summary slides in a "Paper Summaries" folder
assistant.promptMaskToPdf: Make a Magic Action that masks all pseudonymized personal details in an hwp or docx file, then converts it to PDF and saves it

shortcuts.description: Customize Dazzi's default keyboard shortcuts by pressing keys directly, picking modifiers in the UI, or chatting with AI.
shortcuts.aiHeroDesc: Ask in plain words — for example, "Change Rename to F2 and New Folder to Cmd+N."
shortcuts.sectionsDesc: Click a shortcut pill and press keys on your keyboard to record immediately, or use the edit icon to pick modifiers and keys. Only built-in shortcut actions can be edited.
shortcuts.lockedHint: Esc is a reserved system key used to close dialogs, cancel runs, and exit key recording.

shortcuts.invalidReservedEscape: Esc is reserved for cancelling and dismissing.
shortcuts.invalidReservedNavigation: Plain arrow keys are reserved for list navigation. Add ⌘/Ctrl or ⌥/Alt.
shortcuts.invalidGeneric: That key combination cannot be used. Try another key.

assistant.title: AI Shortcut Customizer
assistant.emptyTitle: Which shortcuts would you like to change?
assistant.emptyDesc: Rebind or swap any of Dazzi's 26 default-bound shortcuts — changes take effect right away.
assistant.promptMacFinder: Let me use the same shortcuts as the Mac Finder
assistant.promptWindowsExplorer: Switch to the shortcuts I know from Windows File Explorer
assistant.promptReset: Put all shortcuts back the way they were

general.description: Configure Dazzi's appearance and startup behavior.

remote.description: Open this Dazzi from a browser on another device, and manage the devices that can.
remote.unavailable: Remote access cannot be set up from this window.
remote.securityHint: HTTP is not encrypted. Use only a trusted network or an encrypted tunnel.
remote.portHint: Default: 47833. Use 0 for an available port. Changing it restarts the server on the new port right away.
remote.copyError: Could not copy the address. Select it and copy manually.
remote.statusError: Could not read remote access status: {{error}}
remote.settingsError: Could not save remote access settings: {{error}}
remote.accessHint: When on, ways to connect and paired devices appear below.
remote.connectHint: Choose a route, open its address on the new device, then enter the pairing code.
remote.routeLanHint: An address that devices on the same Wi-Fi or office network as this computer can open directly.
remote.lanMissing: No Wi-Fi or LAN address was found on this computer. Check its network connection.
remote.pairHint: Needed once per device, whatever the route. The QR code carries the address above together with the code.
remote.pairNoAddress: The QR code appears once a route above has an address. The code can still be typed in.

remote.tunnelQuickHint: Creates a temporary https://….trycloudflare.com address without an account. The address changes every time the tunnel starts, and Cloudflare does not guarantee uptime.
remote.tunnelCustomHint: Connects through your own domain on Cloudflare. The address stays the same after a restart.
remote.tunnelMissingBinary: cloudflared is not installed on this computer. Install it (for example, brew install cloudflared) to turn this on.
remote.tunnelErrLogin: Sign in to Cloudflare before using your own domain.
remote.tunnelErrServer: The remote access server is not running.
remote.tunnelErrTimeout: The tunnel did not connect in time. Try again.
remote.tunnelErrDisconnected: The tunnel disconnected. Start it again.
remote.tunnelErrSetup: Could not set up the tunnel: {{reason}}
remote.domainHint: Enter a hostname on a domain you manage in Cloudflare (for example, dazzi.example.com) to get a fixed address instead of a temporary one. A hostname that already points elsewhere is never changed.
remote.domainLoginHint: Approve the account that owns this domain in the browser.
remote.serverFailed: Could not start the remote access server: {{reason}}
